resources.string: No popups while watching (goal alerts excepted)
While watching, no popup or notification shows, except goal alerts (§4.33) which stay on. The setting itself is here; the player button and popup filtering are on the player side.
Choose the subtitle display size. The playback engine applies this setting to ExoPlayer and VLC subtitles.
Choose the subtitle colour. The playback engine applies this setting to ExoPlayer and VLC subtitles.
At the bottom or top of the screen
Choose where subtitles show: at the bottom (default) or at the top of the screen.

A copy every week, with nothing to do
Stream Master automatically saves a backup copy (settings and playlists, unencrypted) every week in a private app folder. The last 4 copies are kept.

If a password is entered here, exported backups are encrypted (AES/GCM) and restoring will ask for the same password. Without a password, the backup stays in plain JSON as before. The password is never stored.
Write down this 6-digit code and keep it somewhere safe. It will let you set a new PIN if you forget the current one. It will never be shown again.
Enter the 6-digit code you wrote down when creating the PIN
Downloads a public test file (Cloudflare, free) and shows your download speed. Useful to tell whether stalls come from the internet or the channel.
